operations.name: CNC Turn — BS Side and Locating Surfaces
operations.setup_note: Grip the bought ring-rolled blank on a sacrificial nBS-end band using low-distortion jaws; incoming hardness is 300 HV10. Establish provisional datum A on F04 and datum B on F01, leaving grinding stock on these surfaces while machining the accessible BS-side profile.

operations.name: CNC Turn — nBS Side
operations.setup_note: Reverse into relieved, low-pressure soft jaws on the preground F01 land and seat against provisional datum A. Remove the sacrificial gripping band, face F03 with final grinding stock retained, and machine its accessible chamfer.

operations.name: Shape Internal Helical Gear
operations.setup_note: Locate the turned tooth-tip bore and seat the preground datum-A face in a low-distortion fixture. Use an internal shaping cutter and a qualified left-hand 14-degree helical guide, with the cutting allowance compensated for the qualified nitriding process.

operations.name: Pre-Nitriding Gear and Edge Deburr
operations.setup_note: Support the soft-machined ring without distorting the datum surfaces. Deburr the tooth ends to the specified BS/nBS requirements without rolling material onto the flanks, then remove remaining machining burrs.

operations.name: Pre-Nitriding Dimensional and Gear Inspection
operations.setup_note: Locate on the provisional A/B references and verify the turned profile, remaining grinding stock, tooth geometry, and burr condition. Release for nitriding only after confirming that the shaped gear and qualified nitriding compensation can meet the final DIN 3961 class 5 and waviness requirements.

operations.name: Pre-Nitriding Wash
operations.setup_note: Rack the soft-machined rings with access to the internal teeth and grooves. Remove cutting fluids and residues before nitriding.

operations.name: Outside Controlled Nitriding
operations.setup_note: Rack the rings to expose the internal teeth and root region for the specified nitriding treatment, including hardness, NHD, compound-layer, porosity, and ISO 6336-5 MQ requirements. Split the 100-piece order into qualified furnace loads unless the vendor validates a single load, maintaining load and coupon traceability.

operations.name: Outside Metallurgical Acceptance
operations.setup_note: Evaluate traceable, customer-approved representative specimens from each qualified nitriding load at the metallographic and microhardness station. Verify surface and core hardness, NHD 400, compound-layer thickness, and porous-layer fraction before releasing the load.

operations.name: Finish Grind Datum A and OD Datum B
operations.setup_note: Locate the nitrided ring on a qualified, non-marring internal gear mandrel with an axial stop on the preground nBS face. Grind protected F04 and F01 in one clamping to establish final A/B references while preserving the specified edge forms and nitrided teeth.

operations.name: Finish Grind nBS Face
operations.setup_note: Reverse onto finished datum A and locate from finished datum B using protected, low-distortion workholding. Grind F03 to the specified body length and parallelism without contacting the nitrided gear flanks.

operations.name: Post-Grinding Edge Deburr
operations.setup_note: Support the finished ring on protected contact surfaces and remove only burrs raised at the ground, non-nitrided edges. Do not brush or recut the nitrided tooth flanks or alter the specified chamfers.

operations.name: Laser DMC Marking
operations.setup_note: Fixture the ring with F12 accessible on its designated planar surface. Laser the DMC to ES 000292 entirely within that surface, clear of radii and chamfers, and link it to the manufacturing and furnace-load records.

operations.name: Final Dimensional and Gear Acceptance
operations.setup_note: Locate on final A/B references and verify dimensions, form, runout, face relationships, edge condition, and marking against the clarified drawing. Perform the specified five-tooth profile/flank-line program and waviness checks, retaining the required batch and serial-number documentation.

operations.name: Demagnetize
operations.setup_note: Pass the finished ring through the demagnetizing station after grinding and inspection. Verify residual magnetism does not exceed 4 A/cm to S 243010; magnetic-particle inspection is not added because it is not specified.

operations.name: Final Precision Wash and Dry
operations.setup_note: Rack accepted rings without damaging the finished surfaces and wash all teeth, grooves, and faces after final machining and metrology. Dry fully and transfer under controlled clean handling for cleanliness release and VCI packing.

operations.name: Dry Corrosion Protection and VCI Pack
operations.setup_note: Handle released, dry rings with clean protective handling and package in VCI film to S 132299. Maintain a dry part surface and preserve serial, batch, and inspection-document traceability.

clarifications.question: Which physical surfaces establish datums A, B, and C, given that the extracted datum map assigns all three to F01?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use F04 as datum A and the F01 cylindrical axis as datum B; leave datum C unresolved rather than inventing a tertiary locator.

clarifications.question: Is the controlling F02 tooth-tip diameter 185.55 +0.20 mm from the gear table or 194.1 mm from the feature record?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use the gear-table value of 185.55 +0.20 mm for bore preparation and stock selection; treat diameter 194.1 as a hardness-evaluation location pending confirmation.

clarifications.question: Which F02 root-diameter tolerance governs: 194.20 +0.30 mm from the gear table or 194.2 ±0.5 mm from the feature record?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use 194.20 +0.30 mm from the gear table.

clarifications.question: Are the two F05 features full circumferential OD grooves or interrupted transverse features?
clarifications.suggested_default: Treat them as two circumferential grooves produced by radial OD grooving.

clarifications.question: What is the required radial depth or bottom diameter of F05?
What are the axial locations of the two F05 grooves relative to datum A?
What is the required leg length or axial extent of the F07 35-degree chamfer?
Which surfaces are required to be nitrided?
clarifications.suggested_default: Nitride F02, including its root region, and mask non-gear surfaces so final OD and face grinding cannot remove a required case.

clarifications.question: What is the intended numerical tolerance for the F01 runout callout extracted as 0 mm?
clarifications.suggested_default: Treat 0 mm as an extraction error requiring drawing confirmation, not as an achievable acceptance limit.

clarifications.question: Is a ground internal tooth finish explicitly required for F02?
clarifications.suggested_default: No tooth grinding; qualify shaping and nitriding to meet DIN 3961 class 5 and the specified waviness requirements without removing the nitrided flank layer.

clarifications.question: Is the F01 diameter-221.1 feature a continuous annular land or a set of discrete projecting tabs?
clarifications.suggested_default: Treat F01 as the continuous cylindrical land described in the routing view; discrete tabs would require reclassification and an additional milling setup.

clarifications.question: Which axial plane locates F11 relative to datum A?
clarifications.suggested_default: Treat F11 as accessible from the BS-side setup, with its axial station taken from the confirmed drawing section before programming.

assumptions.text: Select a bought ring-rolled blank in the specified 300 HV10 incoming condition. This nitriding-grade ring is not identified as a bought annealed case-hardening ring, so the carbonitriding route does not apply.

Provisional stock dimensions provide 2 mm radial allowance on OD and bore and 2 mm on each axial envelope face. The bore calculation uses the gear-table tooth-tip diameter; the stated and partial computed masses are inconsistent and are not used for stock sizing.

The ring-blank forming sequence is inapplicable because the ring is bought already rolled. Cold rolling, ring coiling, welding, normalizing, blasting, and cold sizing are therefore excluded; the external-gear and induction sequences are also inapplicable.
Provisionally establish A on F04 and B on F01. Datum C and its dependent acceptance requirements remain unresolved until C01 is answered.

Assume the BS-side stepped profile, F11, and both F05 grooves are accessible in the first turning setup while an expendable nBS-end band remains for gripping. Confirm the section geometry before fixture design and programming.

The F02 boring steps create the internal tooth-tip cylinder and shaper locating bore, not an invented separate bore feature. The internal-gear sequence's bore-and-face preparation and shaping steps are retained.

Omit the internal-gear sequence's dedicated tooth-chamfer step because no dimensioned tooth-entry lead is identified on F02. The specified tooth-end deburring remains mandatory; F06, F07, F14, and F15 are treated as separately identified turned edges.

Omit the internal-gear sequence's conditional tooth-grinding step because DIN class 5 alone is not an explicit ground-tooth requirement. Proceed only after qualifying helical shaping, nitriding growth, and final waviness capability; an inability to qualify requires route revision.
Final grinding of F01, F03, and F04 is provisional pending C08. Do not grind a surface the customer requires to keep a nitrided case.
Retain controlled finish-grinding stock on F01, F03, and F04 during soft turning. Grind F01 and F04 together after nitriding, then reverse to grind F03; preserve the pre-machined fillet and chamfers.

Produce the F10 radius of 1 mm incidentally with the adjacent turning tool. Interpret the negative F06 chamfer leg as material removal of magnitude 0.65 mm, subject to confirmation against the source drawing.
Nitriding and metallurgical acceptance require qualified outside vendors because those processes are not in-house. Furnace loading and representative specimens require a customer-approved plan.
Do not numerically convert the supplied core or surface Vickers hardness values to HRC. All operations after nitriding are classified as hardened.
Final preservation uses dry VCI protection rather than an assumed oil film.
